notes: Support_TT_Raycasting.cs and the image scripts' arm moves and sounds, shared by every Tier+Tactical Add-On: the gun packs (with tier-tactical, their ammo system) and Kai's melee packs, which each ship their own copy of the raycasting script.

handles.WeaponImage::onFire: the port's hitscans: TT_raycast guns hit along rays (engine Shot::hitscan)
handles.WeaponImage::TT_onRaycastHit: engine hitscan: damage where the minigame allows, the hit projectile's blast, the player or brick hit sound
handles.WeaponImage::TT_onRaycastDamage: engine hitscan damage, impulse and vertical push at the shooter's scale; crits in the host rules' raycast_crit
handles.WeaponImage::TT_isRaycastCritical: no crit by default; the guns that override it are the host rules' crit_images
